description: Yield on Arc before you deposit: every lending vault Circle Earn Kit lists on Arc (Morpho Vault V2) with its rate (Circle's figure), size, how much a depositor can actually withdraw at this block (read on chain), where its money is lent and a 24 h trail of what could be withdrawn. Refreshed every 15 minutes. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

vault.description: optional: one vault address (0x...) instead of the whole board

name: arc_yield
